_about: What's new: the changes visitors see, newest first. Shown in the map page's What's new panel (footer) and on /updates/. kind is new, better or fixed. Keep each one to a sentence or two, in plain words; test/updates.test.js checks the order and the fields.

updates.title: Geff Bohm's links
updates.text: Search Geff Bohm to find his RA, SoundCloud, Instagram and Facebook pages as well as his website, and follow him for alerts.

updates.title: BRKS
updates.text: Chicago DJ BRKS is in search: follow for an alert as soon as a show is listed, with links to BRKS on YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud and Instagram.

updates.title: Easier city picking
updates.text: In your account's settings, start typing a city's name and pick it from the list.

updates.title: Donate
updates.text: Chip in once or every month with the Donate button at the top of the map. Payments go through Stripe, and every feature on Rave Monitor stays free for everyone.

updates.title: Stream player
updates.text: Live NTS shows and YouTube streams from the Streams tab play right here, in a small player that stays open while you look around the map. Fold the video away to keep listening.

updates.title: Scene alerts
updates.text: Turn on Scene alerts in your account's settings to hear about every new night in your cities and genres, not just from who you follow.

updates.title: Calendar feed
updates.text: Your saved shows and new shows from who you follow, in Google, Apple or Outlook Calendar. Get the address under Your shows in your account.

updates.title: Color themes
updates.text: Pick the site's colors with the palette button at the top: Midnight, Ember, Acid, Ultraviolet, Lagoon or Graphite, each with a white accent, or Your own, from a background and an accent you choose. The map changes with them, and your choice is remembered: in this browser, and on your account when you're signed in, so it follows you to every device.

updates.title: What's new
updates.text: This list of what's changed on Rave Monitor, from launch on. A dot by What's new at the bottom of the map page means there's something you haven't seen.

updates.title: Accounts
updates.text: Sign in with a link sent to your email, no password needed. Follow artists, venues, promoters and record labels, save shows, and choose your cities and genres.

updates.title: Alerts
updates.text: New shows from who you follow, a reminder the day before a show you saved, and a heads-up if it sells out, is cancelled or is postponed. They collect under the bell and come by email as instant alerts or as a daily or weekly digest.

updates.title: Weekly picks
updates.text: Every Thursday, picks for the week ahead in your cities and genres.

updates.title: Faster fonts
updates.text: The fonts now load from Rave Monitor itself instead of Google Fonts, so pages show sooner and nothing goes to Google to draw the text.

updates.title: Promoters and record labels
updates.text: A Promoters tab lists who's throwing nights where you're looking, busiest first, with where they play and their next night. Switch it to record labels too.

updates.title: Tampa and St. Petersburg
updates.text: Listings for Tampa and St. Pete, Florida.

updates.title: Venues
updates.text: A Venues tab and venue cards, with each club's next nights and the sounds it books. Zoom in and the map shows every club, including ones with nothing listed yet, from OpenStreetMap.

updates.title: Venues added by hand
updates.text: Places the listing sites miss can now be added with their address, starting with split/shift's space in Milwaukee.

updates.title: Record label filter
updates.text: Search for a record label to see its nights on the map, including label nights listed under a promoter's name.

updates.title: Near me
updates.text: Jump to the listings around you. Your location stays in your browser and is never sent anywhere.

updates.title: Full-screen map
updates.text: Give the map the whole screen with the full-screen button, or press F.

updates.title: Spin the globe
updates.text: In globe view, Spin turns the earth slowly like a screensaver. In full screen the controls fade until you move.

updates.title: More genres
updates.text: Dance/electronic and Misc join the genre filters, and the genres are now in order of how many nights each one has.

updates.title: Contact form
updates.text: Send questions, listing fixes and removals, or a city to add, from the Contact page.

updates.title: Phones
updates.text: A rebuilt phone layout: a compact header, filters in one row, listings first, an event sheet you can drag down to close, and a faster start.

updates.title: New title and share image
updates.text: Rave Monitor - Electronic Music Map, with a new picture when you share a link.

updates.title: Posh listings
updates.text: Nights listed on Posh are coming in again.

updates.title: Rave Monitor goes live
updates.text: A live world map of raves, club nights, festivals and DJ sets, with listings from Resident Advisor, Posh, Partiful, Luma, Ticketmaster and Skiddle merged into one map. See where it's night and club hours right now, which scenes are busiest, and where headliners play next.

updates.title: Livestreams
updates.text: A Streams tab with what's live and coming up on NTS Radio and on YouTube channels like Boiler Room, Cercle and HÖR.

updates.title: Street map
updates.text: Zoom in far enough and streets and neighborhoods appear under the listings.

updates.title: Lists follow the map
updates.text: Zoom in and the lists beside the map show just the area on screen.

updates.title: 30 days ahead
updates.text: Plan ahead with listings up to 30 days out, grouped by night.

updates.title: The archive
updates.text: Every listing is kept after the night is over, merged across platforms. Search it by artist, record label, venue, city and month, or download it as a spreadsheet or database.

updates.title: Link previews
updates.text: Links to Rave Monitor show a proper preview card in messages and social apps.

updates.title: Privacy settings
updates.text: Privacy and cookie policies, and a Privacy Settings link at the bottom of every page to change your choices at any time.

updates.title: Buy Me a Coffee
updates.text: A link at the top for anyone who'd like to chip in.
